description: This file implements the 'List' feature within the 'Comments' component, handling requests to retrieve comments associated with an article identified by its slug.

classes.name: List.Query
classes.description: Request object for listing comments, contains the article slug.

classes.name: List.QueryHandler
classes.description: Handles the query to retrieve comments for an article based on the slug.

methods.name: Handle
methods.description: Handles the incoming query to fetch comments associated with a specific article slug.
